claim_checks.note: The hotel is built into the cliffside, its levels stepping down the rock face.

claim_checks.claim: Private beach reached via a cliff-side elevator carved into the rock
claim_checks.note: FAQ: 'an elevator carved into the rock, which leads comfortably to the private beach and sea platforms'.
Listed as a Relais & Châteaux member.

claim_checks.claim: Rooms built into the cliffside, each with private terraces overlooking the sea
claim_checks.note: Every room has a private sea-view terrace. Reported room counts vary (57-59); Relais & Châteaux lists 58 rooms, suites and villas.

claim_checks.claim: Tennis court appears to float above the Mediterranean
claim_checks.note: The hotel describes a seaside tennis court set between the cliffs. 'Float' is editorial.
Zass holds one Michelin star, under Belgian chef Alois Vanlangenaeker. The hotel itself has three MICHELIN Keys, a separate hotel award; the hotel's homepage loosely says '3 Michelin stars'.

claim_checks.claim: Zass uses ingredients grown in the hotel's cliff-hanging gardens
claim_checks.note: Ten cascading organic garden terraces supply vegetables, herbs and citrus.

claim_checks.claim: Private beach accessible only by the elevator descent through 60 meters of solid rock
claim_checks.note: A staircase path also connects the lobby to the sea, so the elevator is not the only way down. The 60 m depth is unverified.

claim_checks.claim: Book lower-level rooms for the best sea views and easier beach access
claim_checks.note: Michelin says every room and terrace has sea views, so 'best views on lower levels' is not supported.

claim_checks.claim: Complimentary boat service to Positano's main beach
claim_checks.note: The complimentary transfer to Positano is a 24-hour shuttle, not a boat. The hotel's free boat offering is a daily 11:30 a.m. morning cruise (May to mid-October) on its own vessels.

claim_checks.claim: Sunset cocktails at the poolside bar
claim_checks.note: A heated outdoor pool and a Terrace Bar exist, but no dedicated poolside bar is listed.

claim_checks.claim: Morning boat trip to Capri departing from the hotel's private beach
claim_checks.note: There is a complimentary 11:30 a.m. cruise (May to mid-October), but its route is not stated, and Capri trips are by private yacht charter. Rephrase as 'complimentary morning cruise'.
Organic garden terraces exist. A formal tour was not explicitly confirmed.

claim_checks.claim: Rare San Marzano tomatoes grown on cliff terraces
claim_checks.note: The tomato variety is not stated.

claim_checks.claim: Private beach access with complimentary shuttle service
claim_checks.note: Both exist, but the shuttle goes to Positano town, not to the beach.

claim_checks.claim: Luxurious spa treatments and wellness facilities
claim_checks.note: The Spa at Il San Pietro offers a hammam and beauty centre.

claim_checks.claim: Remote clifftop location requires shuttle for beach access
claim_checks.note: The private beach is reached in-house by elevator or stairs. The shuttle only serves trips into Positano, a few minutes away.

facts.text: The hotel has about 57-58 rooms, suites and villas, each with a private sea-view terrace.
facts.source_title: Relais & Châteaux - Il San Pietro di Positano

facts.text: Awarded Three MICHELIN Keys, one of only eight Italian hotels with three Keys in the first (2024) selection.
facts.source_title: MICHELIN Guide - Every Three Key Hotel in Italy

facts.text: Seasonal: generally open April to October.
A small 17th-century chapel dedicated to San Pietro marks the entrance, and the hotel steps down the cliff below it.
facts.source_title: MICHELIN Guide - Every Three Key Hotel in Italy

facts.text: An elevator carved into the rock leads to the private beach and sea platforms, which have a solarium, bar and the beachside Carlino restaurant.
Zass holds one Michelin star under chef Alois Vanlangenaeker, who has led the kitchen for over 20 years.
Ten cascading organic garden terraces supply the kitchens. The bars include the Terrace Bar and L'Alcova (next to Zass).
A complimentary 24-hour shuttle runs into Positano centre, a few minutes away.
The hotel's boats The Dreamer (51 ft) and Joey II (44 ft) run a complimentary 11:30 a.m. cruise with swimming and cocktails, May to mid-October.
Facilities include a heated outdoor pool, a seaside tennis court between the cliffs, and The Spa at Il San Pietro with hammam.
facts.source_title: Relais & Châteaux - Il San Pietro di Positano

facts.text: Transfers from Naples are arranged by the concierge. A car-plus-boat option is recommended to avoid coastal traffic.
The hotel celebrated its 55th anniversary in 2025, having opened in 1970.
facts.source_title: Il San Pietro di Positano - Home

considerations.text: Seasonal hotel, closed in winter: it generally opens in April and closes in October.
Children are welcome only from age 10.
It sits outside Positano town, so reaching restaurants and shops in the centre means using the free 24-hour shuttle.
The hotel is terraced down a cliff. Elevators link the levels to the beach, and there is also a staircase path from the lobby to the sea.
The road from Naples along the Amalfi Coast can be congested. The hotel recommends a car-plus-boat transfer.

best_for: Honeymooners and couples: children only from age 10, a private terrace with sea views in every room, and a secluded private beach.
Food lovers: Michelin-starred Zass supplied by the hotel's own organic garden terraces.
Travellers who want Positano without the crowds: a few minutes from town by the free 24-hour shuttle, plus complimentary daily cruises.
Active couples: a seaside tennis court, a heated pool and swimming from the hotel's own sea platforms.
